item.title: Annotello Capture 1.4.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.4.0

  • Annotello is now Annotello Capture, part of a new family of Annotello apps. Your captures, settings, shortcuts and permissions all carry over.
  • The app renames itself to “Annotello Capture” in your Applications folder the first time it opens after this update.
  • New from Annotello: the Annotello Suite, with Mail, Docs, Sheets and Slides for Mac. See annotello.com/suite.html.
